paragraphs: The paternal grandfather of Rabbi Chiyya and his siblings, as in Sanhedrin 5a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Sanhedrin 5a names Rabbi Chiyya and his siblings as children of Abba bar Acha Karsala, supporting the grandfather relationship stated by Hyman.

The saved Davidson Sanhedrin5a scalar calls Rabbi Chiyya and the listed siblings children of Abba bar Acha Karsala of Kafri. It supports the paternal-grandfather reading and full Rabbi Chiyya, superseding the old opaque relation and singular-brother speculation. Hyman’s heading retains bar Sala or Karsala; the witness has Acha Karsala without that bar. כ is read as as in without asserting a particular expanded source word, and no printed correction history or global genealogy is admitted. Earlier printed wording refers only to the supplied digital label; no printed page was inspected.
